remarks: Welcome home to this charming single-story residence tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in Saugus. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a fresh, welcoming feel the moment you step inside. The living room features a cozy fireplace, and the dining area includes a stylish built-in bench that adds both character and functionality. The kitchen is bright and inviting, complete with sleek black appliances and a large window overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard. The hall/guest bathroom has been completely remodeled and now includes a luxurious Casta Diva bidet toilet.
